summary: This directory defines the core data schemas and TypeScript types used to model and document the architectural intent, package metadata, and conceptual structure of a software project.
responsibilities: Define structural schemas for representing package metadata and dependencies
Define schemas for documenting public API exports and symbols
Capture architectural concepts, responsibilities, and relationships of code directories
Standardize the format for package insights and functional capabilities
relationships: The PackageConcept schema integrates package metadata, dependencies, and public APIs into a comprehensive definition.
PackageInsights utilize functional capabilities and relationships to describe the high-level intent of a package.
DirectoryConcepts provide a standardized way to describe the architectural purpose of individual project folders.
designDecisions: Use of Zod-like schemas for runtime validation of architectural definitions
Separation of concerns by defining distinct schemas for metadata, API surfaces, and conceptual insights
Strong typing derived from schemas to ensure consistency across the documentation tooling
